messages:
sara: Auryn POC sync — quick check. Demo scheduled Wed 10am PST. Are we still on for staging + embeddings hookup? Need owners for network certs, embedding schema, and final CRs.

nina: On embeddings integration. I still need the final schema from SEs, and the test vectors. Working on the model mapping PR now (PR #4823).

liam: @nina re schema: attaching the draft in the repo (see link). We decided on 768-d float32 for now, will quantize later. Test vectors: 200 sample queries coming today.

omar: Staging infra check: firewall rules need Auryn IP range (they gave a /28) and we need a cert from security. Who's owning cert upload?

trent: I can own the cert upload + canary routing. Will need the staging DNS entry updated (staging.auryn.redwood-demo). @sara can you confirm the DNS ticket is OK?

sara: Confirmed — ticket submitted to infra yesterday (INC-2241). Status: awaiting DNS propagation, estimated by EOD tomorrow.

liam: Quick CR ping: PR #4823 (embed schema) is ready for review, cc @trent for routing changes. Also PR #4830 (batching + caching config) is open, needs QA signoff.

nina: Reviewing #4823 now. A couple small nits: change field name from "vec" to "embedding_vector" for clarity. Also add unit test for dimension check.

trent: Noted, will wait on the rename before deploying the router changes. If it's just the field name we can do a fast patch.

deploy-bot: deploy requested by trent on staging at 2024-04-10T18:00:00Z — status: queued.

omar: One more infra note: staging has a 250ms p95 token latency baseline. For the Auryn demo we should aim <300ms p95 end-to-end. We'll need to enable prefix caching for their conversational flows.

sara: Success criteria for demo (to confirm): 1) embeddings ingestion <30s for 200 vectors, 2) query p95 <300ms, 3) similarity recall on eval set >= 88%. If everyone agrees I'll put this into the demo readout doc.

liam: Agree. I'll attach the eval set and expected labels by EOD.

nina: I'll land #4823 today after addressing the field rename + add the unit test. Then pinging QA for #4830.

trent: I'll watch for the PR merge and schedule the canary for tomorrow afternoon.

sara: Awesome — if anything blocks, drop a quick note here. Otherwise I'll update the customer-facing runbook and slide deck once DNS/PRs are green. :thumbsup:
